text:
Alex: Cutoff reminder — release v1.8.2 cutoff in ~45m. Please open any final PRs against release/*, add changelog entries, and avoid API-breaking changes. Ping me for any urgent backports. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maria: Pushing a fix for the filewatcher flake to release/1.8.2 now. Will open the changelog PR in a minute. @Alex can you merge after CI is green?

Kevin: Heads up — I have a migration queued on main affecting schema version. Recommend we only do a patch bump here (v1.8.2) and coordinate any schema bumps in the 1.9 cycle.

Sam: Quick question — do we tag on merge or after deploy?

Alex: Tag on merge. Use an annotated tag: `git tag -a v1.8.2 -m "release v1.8.2"` then push `git push origin v1.8.2`.

Maya: Changelog PR ready: "Fix filewatcher flake + runtime stability improvements" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1123 (draft).

Maria: CI detected an unrelated perf-test flake; re-running. If it doesn't turn green before cutoff we'll need to defer. ETA ~30m.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline update — release/1.8.2 build failed on perf-tests (test-timeout). Rerun triggered by @Maria.

Kevin: Noted — also seeing infra quota pressure on smt-gpu in us-west. If perf jobs queue up we might hit limits. @eng-infra can we get a quick quota bump or requeue somewhere else?

Alex: Update: CI still unstable and infra is constrained. Moving the release to tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll post a slip notice in #announcements in ~5m so PMs/customers aren't surprised. :warning: :calendar:

Sam: Ack. I'll update the release-notes draft and adjust changelog header to reflect the reschedule. Ping me if you want me to post the announcement. :thumbsup:

Maria: Thanks — I'll keep rerunning the perf suite and follow up on the backport PRs. If anything critical lands, mention it here and we'll triage.

Alex: Thanks everyone. New plan: hold merges to release/* until CI is stable or we get explicit go from me. We'll reopen merge window once infra is cleared.

Sam: Copy that.
